subject: Heal Staff
text: A Heal Staff is found in the first treasure chest on Floor 3 of the Castle of Ordeals.

evidence.quote: In the first treasure chest you'll find a Heal Staff, which is a not so great weapon to equip, but is great for the White Mage to use in battle, since it has the same effect as the Heal spell, which heals the entire party at once.

subject: Iron Gauntlet
text: An Iron Gauntlet is located in a treasure chest in the northwestern corner of Floor 3 of the Castle of Ordeals.

evidence.quote: In the northwestern corner, you'll find an Iron Gauntlet, an Ice Sword, and a Gold Bracelet.

subject: Ice Sword
text: An Ice Sword is found in a treasure chest in the northwestern corner of Floor 3 of the Castle of Ordeals.

evidence.quote: In the northwestern corner, you'll find an Iron Gauntlet, an Ice Sword, and a Gold Bracelet.

subject: Gold Bracelet
text: A Gold Bracelet is found in a treasure chest in the northwestern corner of Floor 3 of the Castle of Ordeals.

evidence.quote: In the northwestern corner, you'll find an Iron Gauntlet, an Ice Sword, and a Gold Bracelet.

subject: 7,340 GP
text: A chest containing 7,340 GP is located in the southwestern corner of Floor 3 of the Castle of Ordeals.

evidence.quote: In the southwestern corner of the room, you'll find some treasure chests which contain 7,340 GP, 1,455 GP, and a House, while the fourth chest is empty.

subject: 1,455 GP

evidence.quote: In the southwestern corner of the room, you'll find some treasure chests which contain 7,340 GP, 1,455 GP, and a House, while the fourth chest is empty.

subject: House

evidence.quote: In the southwestern corner of the room, you'll find some treasure chests which contain 7,340 GP, 1,455 GP, and a House, while the fourth chest is empty.

subject: Rat Tail
text: The Rat Tail is obtained from the eastern room of Floor 3 of the Castle of Ordeals.

evidence.quote: Now proceed to the east, and collect your Rat Tail, and prepare to fight your way out of the castle, which is no where as hard as the Ice Cave was.

subject: Zombie Dragon
text: The Zombie Dragon boss encountered in the Castle of Ordeals has 268 HP and is weak to Harm and Fire.

evidence.quote:
Boss: Zombie Dragon(s)

HP: 268
Weakness: Harm, Fire

subject: Bahamut
text: Talking to Bahamut on Bahamut's Island bestows the class change reward.

evidence.quote: Make your way back to the airship and head back to Bahamut's Island, and talk to him, and he'll bestow upon you the reward, your class change.

subject: Bottle
text: The Bottle can be purchased at The Oasis shop for 50,000 GP.

evidence.quote: Key Item: Bottle (50,000 GP)...This is basically nothing but a shop, and is the only place where you must buy a key item. If you can afford to buy the Bottle, do so now but it will set you back 50,000 GP.

subject: CatClaw
text: The CatClaw is sold in the Weapon Shop of Town of Gaia for 65000 GP.

evidence.quote:
Weapon Shop:
[CatClaw          65000 GP]

subject: ProRing

subject: Oxyale
text: Using the Bottle at the spring behind the Town of Gaia frees the fairy and yields the Oxyale, which allows breathing underwater.

evidence.quote: Approach the spring, and use the bottle from your items....The fairy will thank you for freeing her, and give you the Oxyale, which is important because it allows you to breath underwater.

subject: Soft Potion
text: Soft Potions can be purchased at the item shop in Onrac for 800 GP.

evidence.quote:
Item Shop:
[Cabin              250 GP]
[House             3000 GP]
[Heal Potion         60 GP]
[Pure Potion         75 GP]
[Soft Potion        800 GP]

evidence.quote:
Inside the chests you'll find the Wizard Staff, Ribbon, 13,450
GP, 6,400 GP, 5,000 GP, and a Defense Sword.

before leaving, and it will give you the Cube, which will allow you

evidence.quote: Upon first entering the Sea Shrine, make your way to the eastern side of the first floor, and collect the 2,000 GP from the chest there.
